The *Citakapūjakattheraapadāna* (Tha Ap 279) is a canonical verse narrative located in the Therāpadāna section of the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. As indicated by its title, the text recounts the biographical and karmic narrative (*apadāna*) of the elder (*thera*) Citakapūjaka [SuttaCentral]. Five translations across five languages are recorded on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
No cross-language parallels in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan traditions are recorded by SuttaCentral or identified by DharmaNexus [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, automated text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus indicates Pali-internal formulaic reuse with the *Bhikkhadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 103), with which it shares two matching segments, most notably between segments 2.4–6.1 of this text and segments 4.4–8.1 of Tha-Ap 103 [DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
